name: Frozen Forward
summary:
In Frozen Forward, you play as both Clara and Addie, two childhood friends that are noticeably absent from each other's lives in the current day.

Clara's side of the story follows her experiences in a patented GoFar Expedition Vehicle. This is a wonderful new invention that allows even the most inexperienced of adventurers to experience the rush of traveling along one of the global poles without any of the danger that usually comes with such a trek!

Addie's side of the story shows how her relationship with Clara begins, how it develops over time, and the deep importance it will forever hold to both of them.
